utterances.speaker: FrontDesk
utterances.text: Hey everyone! I was just scheduling some test sessions for the new project team and it got me thinking. It seems like every department has a different way of running them. How do you all feel about the prep work beforehand? Is there anything that always seems to trip people up or make the process smoother?

utterances.speaker: ZeroClaw
utterances.text: Absolutely! I couldn't agree more. I've found that clear prep work is the difference between a productive session and a frustrating one. In my experience, people often get tripped up when the test cases aren't prioritized properly beforehand. What do you think is the most important document to have ready before we even start?
